newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Bogota stocks end little changed, eyes on Ganadero.
newsitem.headline: Bogota stocks end little changed, eyes on Ganadero.

text.p: Stocks in the Colombian capital ended slightly lower in thin trading as most market players kept to the sidelines ahead of Tuesday afternoon's equity buyback offer by Banco Ganadero.

The Bogota IBB index ended down 0.29 percent at 846.52 on a below-average volume of 1.15 billion pesos. Medellin's IBOMED general index was not immediately available but brokers said trading there had been quiet as well.
Brokers said the volume in Bogota was inflated by a cross trade of 517 million pesos of shares in insurance company Suramericana de Seguros, which ended unchanged at 17,500 pesos.
Ganadero has offered to buy back 49.5 million ordinary shares at 3 p.m. local time (2000 GMT). On Tuesday, those same shares dropped 1.03 percent to close at 287 pesos per share.
Ganadero's offering price for the shares is 295 pesos. It needs them to complete a 40 percent sale of the bank to Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya.
"Ganadero stock fell under speculation because of fresh rumors that the Spanish bank won't buy the whole package of shares that's offered," one broker said.
Apart from Ganadero, whose preferred shares also dipped, brokers said there was little or no price action in Tuesday's sideways trading.
"In general, the atmosphere was one of expectation about the Banco Ganadero share deal," one said.
